Subject: OrionTech onsite — travel headcount & arrival windows

Hi Dev,

Thanks again — excited to host the Redwood team for the May 12–14 workshop. Quick notes from our side:
- Final headcount: 11 (6 execs, 3 PMs, 2 engineers).
- Preferred arrival window for execs: May 11 evening (after 6pm) or May 12 before 10am if necessary.
- Departure: evening May 14 or morning May 15 for those staying late.

Can your travel ops partner block flights and propose an "airbridge" (group + paired itineraries) with one backup routing per exec? We also need any special assistance for two attendees with carry-on medical equipment.

I've attached a quick headcount CSV with names/airports. If you can share a consolidated pickup plan for arrivals (who needs meet-and-greet) that would be great.

— Sandy
Director, Events & Partnerships
OrionTech

Subject: Re: OrionTech onsite — travel headcount & arrival windows

Sandy — thanks for the detail. We’ll run with two parallel plans:
1) Primary: direct or single-connection itineraries arriving May 11 evening for execs (preferred carriers: United or Alaska for arrival consistency).
2) Contingency: one-hop alternates routed through CLT / PHL with guaranteed same-day arrival by 21:30.

Alicia (copied) — can you draft paired PNRs and include: seat requests (1A/1C for execs if available), medical equipment notes, and an arrival manifest for ground ops? Please include estimated pickup windows and vendor contact.

Monica — once Alicia sends PNRs, please coordinate with our on-site logistics (hotel + venue) for shuttle timing. Vivek — fyi on the contingency routing; if we need to move meeting start to 10:30 there may be a knock-on for AV setup.

I’ll consolidate final manifest once we confirm PNRs.

Thanks,
Dev
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

- Medical carry-on flagged on two records; waiver confirmed with carriers.
- Seat requests are requested but not yet ticketed for execs; upgrade requests filed for 2 seats (pending vendor approval).
- Ground pickup windows estimated based on flight ETAs: May 11 19:30–20:15 (Group A), May 12 07:30–09:45 (Group B).

Next steps:

- Sandy: advise if OrionTech prefers meet-and-greet inside arrivals vs curbside pickup for the exec group.
